package.name: swarm_supervisor_node
package.description: ROS 2 (rclrs) node wrapping the deterministic safety supervisor. Subscribes to /mission_plan and /swarm_estimate, publishes /plan_decision. The accept/reject verdict is a first-class topic; only an accepted plan is forwarded as setpoints. Validation is the same swarm-supervisor crate the standalone binary and unit tests use.
